value.text: {"result": {"suggestions": [], "no_change_reason": "These were noticed in a monitor-labelled email: a survey reports that 27% of mixed Mac/Windows fleet firms plan to delay their Mac refresh into 1H27, up from 17% in July, and that eleven respondents mentioned trimming iPad and iPhone stipends for field staff. Because every claim comes from a monitor email, they cannot carry a new thesis alone. Confirmation would need to come from a source at a different triage level, such as reported fleet purchasing or enterprise device spending, showing that the Mac and iPad refresh delay is material and separate from the existing iPhone upgrade-cycle pillar."}}
